extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. Current-quarter (three months ended Dec 31, 2022) column used. Shares 67,003,718 printed in full, divided by 1,000 to 67,003.718 (thousands). Check: 252,805 / 67,003.718 = 3.77 and 252,431 / 67,003.718 = 3.77, matching reported per-share figures. Zero-value lines ('-' in current quarter) recorded as 0. Categories for 'Deferred tax', 'Provision for credit losses', 'Co-investment promote income', 'Income from early redemption of preferred equity...' and 'General and administrative and other, net' are 'other' since no closer category fits. 'Impairment loss from unconsolidated co-investments' mapped to re_impairment; company does not specify whether it is depreciable real estate. Same reconciliation also appears on page S-3 (seq 17, printed S-3); page seq 12 (printed 8) used as source. No recurring capex table on these pages; recurring_capex_disclosed null.
